ValueError: autodetected range of [nan, nan] is not finite

The issue is likely that some of the columns in the dataset have all NaN values, so when `np.histogram` is called, it tries to autodetect the range from NaN values, which results in `[nan, nan]` - an invalid finite range.

To fix this, I should handle NaN values when creating histograms. One approach is to filter out NaN values before calling histogram, or to explicitly specify a range when all values are NaN.
